3_unexplained_deviation_conclusion.outcome_classification: Unexplained Baseline Deviation — Instructor Approval Requested
3_unexplained_deviation_conclusion.finding: The historical 0.7145 accuracy could not be mathematically reproduced. Because XGBoost is a tree-based ensemble, it is mathematically invariant to monotonic feature scaling, meaning global scaling leakage did not artificially inflate the tree's accuracy. Furthermore, leaving all 6327 duplicated rows in the dataset only shifted accuracy to 0.6226.
probable_historical_causes: Different target tier thresholds (e.g., High > 50 instead of 67)
Different metric reported (e.g., Micro-F1 instead of Accuracy)
